== Book 4 ==

== Biography ==

The Sorcerer, also known as Gwig, is a practitioner of sorcery among the Mangaboo people, summoned before them with the call "Come to us, oh, Gwig!" He identifies himself directly, stating "My name is Gwig," while turning his heartless, cruel eyes upon a rival and daring him to equal the sorcery he is about to perform. Displaying sorcery in this manner is described as one of the things Gwig usually did to prove he was a sorcerer, though the Mangaboo people listening show no great interest in the demonstration.

== Relationships ==

'''[[WIZARD]]''' — enemy. Their rivalry surfaces in dueling boasts of sorcery — Gwig declaring "I'll beat Old Prickly, all right" and demanding "Let me see you equal the sorcery I am about to perform" — which seems to place him in direct competition with the Wizard.

'''[[Prince]]''' — employment. Gwig tells the Prince, "Quite sure, my Prince. My sorcery tells me so," which suggests he serves the Prince's court in some advisory capacity.

'''[[DOROTHY]]''' — enemy. He is described as having looked toward the little girl with cold, cruel eyes, which could indicate hostility toward her.

=== Events ===

* The Wizard of Oz arrives by balloon, defeats the Mangaboos' thorny Sorcerer Gwig in a contest of magic, and learns the Mangaboos grow from bushes instead of being born.
